observerEvidence.note: Hosted confirmation of the BS-4 process structure: the integration helper 5275 starts the gated muxer 5304, which leads its own session and matches the helper's process record. The muxer runs the tool 5322, a direct child, and the tool starts the AppHost 5728, which carries the run tag. The AppHost is therefore never a direct child of the leader. No cancellation was sent, so the only kernel signals were the tool's own SIGKILLs to placement and scheduler during its startup-failure teardown. The helper ran its exact down, and the always() finalizer ran a second one with job status failure; both verified empty inventories.
